questions: What is your body temperature, and how many days has the fever lasted?
Do you have other symptoms like a cough, cold, chills, body aches, or a skin rash?
Have you taken any fever medicines, and did your temperature go down after taking them?
recommendations: Rest adequately, stay hydrated (water, electrolyte solutions, warm soups), and record your temperature periodically. You may take Paracetamol to reduce fever. Avoid self-prescribing antibiotics.
